decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core to the firm's announced direction and in-house manufacturing investment, so management will stick with it and attribute any slow start to market ramp-up.
The comfort insole needs little investment and complements the core footwear range, and the firm has launched its insole offering publicly, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
The supportive insole fits the firm's ergonomic and foot-measurement services, and management will justify it as part of the tailored-solutions strategy despite its low visibility.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page and embodies the announced innovation direction, so the visible commitment and development investment push strongly toward persistence.

Firefighter boots required certification and specialised development, so these sunk costs and the strategic step into a new segment encourage keeping them while the slow uptake is blamed on long public procurement cycles.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page signals a strong public commitment, so management will persist and frame any weak early results as temporary.
